summary:
We developed our  project " Past and Present"  with artworks to represent the history of the Space Telescopes "Hubble and Fermi" that  still traveling away from Earth
We decided  to focus on   two specific missions and this  challenge  is important because we choised  two Space  Telescopes that had problems in the Space , during their missions and  today they will be  abbandoned and forgotten equipement in the Space but thanks to the man and its technology
Our  story is  designed for everyone  and  and  the format   is accessible also for the childrens for the design and for the simple  tool "Power Point"
details:
Our project “ Past and Present” is a simple format to read  and thanks to the images of  my artworks  that are the stars, planets , constellations, of the Universe and the scientific discoveries they made and continue to make

Really for this reason our project is very creative, and it is appropriate also for the young students

The benefits of our project on them will be already a knowledege of the Universe and the Space Telescopes at that age and with the hope that many young students become researchers of the Space and astronauts

The tools we use to develop is "PowerPoint" and my team consired like important factor the goal creating an engaging, story-driven educational tool or narrative that teaches school-age and space enthusiasts
